purpose: The public DreamLedger surface is a compiled reflection of canonical economic truth, never a hand-maintained source of commercial truth.
mount_everest_inverted_guardrails: Do not climb on an unverified route because the summit is visible.
Do not add complexity merely because a competitor has it.
Do not mistake a green build for a proven business transaction.
Do not let a polished surface outrun canonical truth.
Do not turn an interesting signal into an autonomous economic action without approval and evidence.
Do not repeat failed-bootstrap patterns: manual surface edits, duplicated pricing, hidden state, unbounded agents, invented integrations, or deployment without health proof.
hard_stop: automatic external action from demand signal
